product_metadata.title: Thermal Coffee Carafe 74Oz Airpot - Insulated Stainless Steel Coffee Dispenser with Pump - Thermal Beverage Dispenser - Thermos Coffee Carafe for Keeping Hot Coffee & Tea Hot For 12 Hours - Cresimo
features: COFFEE AIRPOT THAT STAYS HOT » With Cresimo's coffee thermos, keep your drink piping hot for up to 12 hours or ice cold for up to 24 hours! Guaranteed using our durable 18/8 stainless steel carafe and lab-tested vacuum insulation technology.

FRESH ALL DAY INSULATED PITCHER » Our double-walled hot beverage dispenser holds enough for almost 13 6oz. cups of coffee! This 2.2 Liter capacity makes the large thermos perfect for soccer games, meetings, road trips, and everything in between!

EASY TO USE AND DURABLE » An airpot of your dreams - Simply push down on the pump on top and watch your favorite beverage come out the spout. Whether it be iced tea, hot chocolate, mulled wine, milk, apple cider, or coffee, there is no limit! The stainless steel hot water dispenser has a base that conveniently rotates to easily turn in your direction without having to lift the urn.

SIMPLE CLEANING COFFEE CARAFE » Our coffee pot with handle is designed with a large mouth opening to make filling and cleaning a breeze - simply wipe the inside with a sponge. The top removes completely with a quick press of a button, making access even easier.

EXCEPTIONAL CUSTOMER SERVICE » Not 100% satisfied with your portable hot water dispenser and warmer? Contact us immediately! Our bonus airpot warranty has you covered. This warranty is exclusive to items purchased directly from Cresimo and purchases made from unauthorized resellers will not be covered by this same manufacturer's warranty.
